description: Captured leads for the current project, newest first. PAGED — at most 200 per call, and the limit is a hard cap, not a default you can raise; pass offset for the next page (limit 50 with offset 50 returns leads 51 onward). These rows are real people's email addresses. Each lead carries a quality verdict (good, warn, bad, unchecked) from cheap capture-time checks; bad leads are stored but were never mailed, and quality filters the list.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: list_leads
title: List leads
